name: set_biome
title: chunk:set_biome
lead: Sets the biome of one column: a vanilla name ("desert") or the name `game.biomes.define` returned.

usedIn.quote: --   chunk:set_biome(pos, biome)   the biome of one column; see "biomes"
chunk:set_biome(pos, "desert")                      -- one column; pos.y is not read
